name: inavitas-project
description: Elektrik dağıtımı kesinti & iş emri yönetim modülü

scripts.dev: concurrently -n access,outage,workorder,translation,network,gw,web -c magenta,green,yellow,red,blue,cyan,gray "npm run dev -w services/access-service" "npm run dev -w services/outage-service" "npm run dev -w services/work-order-service" "npm run dev -w services/translation-service" "npm run dev -w services/network-service" "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w services/access-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/outage-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/work-order-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/translation-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/network-service
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed -w services/access-service && npm run db:seed -w services/translation-service && npm run db:seed -w services/network-service
